description: “sklep” is trending in PL with 2,000+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from Business Insider Polska and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “sklep”
paragraphs: “sklep” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for PL (snapshot taken 2026-08-22T10:39:56+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 2,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Business Insider Polska, Fakt, Rzeczpospolita. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Grupa Modivo rusza z nową marką. Klienci tłumnie zjawili się po vouchery” — Business Insider Polska
“Nowa sieć sklepów w Polsce. Chce przyciągnąć klientów w trzech słowach” — Fakt
“Wielki powrót „Cena Czyni Cuda”. Grupa Modivo rusza na podbój Polski z siecią ShockPrice” — Rzeczpospolita

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sat, 22 Aug 2026 02:40:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-22T10:39:56+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-22T10:40:50+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
